title: nightly: make four slow helpers fast without changing results (Python, performance)
prompt: The nightly import job is far too slow: the helpers in `analyze.py` (`dedupe`, `top_tags`, `pairs_with_sum`, `moving_average`) take hours on the real data (hundreds of thousands of records). Make all four fast on large inputs (seconds, not minutes) without changing their results: the docstrings define the exact behaviour, including order, tie-breaking and edge cases. Keep the function names and signatures, use only the standard library, and keep the existing tests passing. `python3 bench.py --n 2000` shows timings on a small input (see README.md before using a bigger one).
